title: (Senior Staff / Senior) Algorithm Engineer
description: Description Responsibilities: The imaging algorithm engineer will apply knowledge of image sensor and camera system to, scientifically, analyze key performance of OmniVision’s products and provide technical suggestions of improvement. Conduct analytic studies of fundamental performance issues for CIS or ISP and provide technical suggestions of improvement Work with analog/digital design team to differentiate the performance of the product in the industry Simulate and analyze the image quality improvement of the product with new imaging algorithm Develop scientific approaches for image sensor/camera system’s performances Conduct modeling and simulation of imaging systems Requirements Must have 5 year experience / knowledge in CMOS sensor or camera ISP system Must have C/C++ programming skills (Python, Matlab, C# and other language skills are plus) Experience/knowledge in image signal processing and color technology is a plus Experience/knowledge in RTL design and verification is a plus Experience/knowledge in HLS is a plus PhD / MS / BS in Electrical Engineering, or Computer Science and Engineering, or related field, or equivalent work experience Business level Japanese & English communication skill Result oriented and embraced change behaviors Project management skill is a plus
